Hi Samantha / Tom — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and next steps so we can lock the MAP and align on procurement timing. Attached is MAP_v1.3 (living draft) with milestone owners populated from our side. Please review and confirm the dates/owners you own on your side.

Key items from the call:
- Target close (go-live contract effective date): 2027-06-30.
- Procurement / contract signature deadline you called out on the call: preferred window week of 2027-06-14–18 (we flagged 2027-06-18 as the final signature cutoff). Please confirm if that still holds.
- Critical dependencies: (1) Your procurement sign-off & PO; (2) SOW redlines agreed (legal); (3) Initial onboarding data access (security checklist).

Draft MAP highlights (attached):
- Milestone A: Executive OK & budget alignment — owner: Verida Finance (Samantha) — target 2027-05-28
- Milestone B: Legal review & SOW redlines — owner: Verida Legal (Tom) + Redwood Legal — target 2027-05-21 for initial redlines
- Milestone C: Procurement PO issuance — owner: Verida Procurement — target signature cutoff 2027-06-18
- Milestone D: Onboarding kickoff & data handover — owner: Redwood Customer Success (Marissa) — target 2027-07-05

Asks / next steps:
1) Samantha/Tom: confirm procurement availability for week of 6/14–6/18 and whether 6/18 is a hard cutoff.
2) Verida: share any required contract language or procurement forms we should pre-fill (PO template, vendor questionnaire).
3) Internal: Marissa will own onboarding readiness; Ben will track pricing acceptance and commit language.

I attached MAP_v1.3 and a working SOW draft (Redwood notes). If we can get your confirmation on the 6/18 cutoff by Monday EOD, we’ll lock the MAP and start the legal sprint.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this quickly.

Best,

- Legal: we will do an initial pass on the SOW and return redlines; target to return redlines by 2027-05-20.
- We have a standard PO template and a vendor security attestation form. I attached the procurement checklist so you can see required fields (tax ID, insurance, SOC attestation).

1) Will Redwood provide the onboarding data transfer checklist before SOW sign? (Marissa can coordinate)
2) Can you accept our PO template (I attached) or will Redwood require changes?

If we can get the MAP locked and SOW redlines by 5/21, procurement will be able to route the PO paperwork in time for the 6/18 signature slot.
